_comment: PORTABLE TEMPLATE — copy to runtime-config.json and fill in YOUR account's endpoints. runtime-config.json itself is gitignored (it holds account-specific values and must not be committed). It is uploaded to the S3 bucket at deploy time (deploy scripts handle this). RECOMMENDED: once the CloudFront distribution routes /api/<svc>/* to each backend, set these to RELATIVE paths (e.g. "/api/cedar") so the browser never sees raw execute-api URLs and the config is identical across accounts.
description: Governed KYC assessment for corporate banking: specialist agents produce credit and compliance findings, then a non-bypassable governance layer applies deterministic financial checks, sanctions/PEP screening, a three-layer policy cascade, and an LLM-as-Judge quality score to reach the final decision.
